Market today: The market is grappling with mixed signals: consumer resilience against persistent inflation (record diesel prices). For your tech/chip heavy book, positive sentiment from Goldman Sachs on AI/broadband and Amazon's cybersecurity board addition offer some tailwinds.

Your holdings: SOXL (-50.54%) and SPAL (-34.02%) are your biggest concerns, both leveraged ETFs flagged SELL with deep drawdowns, amplified by margin. QQQI (-3.26%) is flagged TRIM and is near its stop.

Watch: Keep an eye on inflation data and how it impacts consumer spending, as well as any further news on tech sector growth drivers like AI.

Bottom line: Focus on aggressive risk management for your leveraged positions to protect your capital.
plays: SOXL and SPAL: Your leveraged ETFs are deep in the red and flagged SELL. Given the decay and margin amplification, consider tightening stops or reducing exposure to manage risk.
QQQI: Flagged TRIM at -3.26% and is near its stop at 52. Watch this level closely; if it breaks, consider trimming as indicated.
XLK: The Tech Sector ETF has a strong 'BUY 9/12' scanner setup. General tech sentiment is positive. Consider XLK entry 187.68-187.49, stop 187.2.
